faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us.

questions.question: Is Snapri Snaps free to use?
questions.answer: Yes, Snapri Snaps offers a generous free plan that includes core features like photo analysis and meal logging. We also have a premium plan with advanced features like unlimited meal planning and detailed historical reports.

questions.question: How accurate is the nutritional analysis?
questions.answer: Our AI is trained on a massive database of food items and provides highly accurate estimates. For packaged foods, barcode scanning provides exact data from the manufacturer. For homemade meals, the accuracy depends on the image clarity and ingredients.

questions.question: Can I use Snapri Snaps for special diets like keto or vegan?
questions.answer: Absolutely! You can set your dietary preferences in the settings, and our AI will tailor meal suggestions and analysis to fit your specific needs, whether you're vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, or on a low-carb diet.

questions.question: Does the app work for non-Western cuisines?
questions.answer: Yes! This is one of our core strengths. Snapri Snaps was specifically designed to recognize a wide variety of international dishes, including complex recipes from Middle Eastern, Asian, and other cuisines that are often poorly supported by other apps.

story.p1: Snapri Snaps was founded by Ghada Al-Ani, a talented software engineer from Baghdad, Iraq. Growing up with the rich flavors of Iraqi cuisine, she developed a deep appreciation for how food connects us to our heritage.
story.p2: While living abroad, she noticed a critical flaw in popular health and wellness apps: they struggled to accurately analyze diverse, international dishes. As an engineer, she saw a technical challenge and an opportunity. The apps lacked the sophisticated models to understand complex recipes from her culture and many others.
story.p3: Driven to solve this problem, Ghada leveraged her engineering expertise to create a tool that was both technologically advanced and culturally intelligent. She built Snapri Snaps to empower individuals to understand their diet with precision, without sacrificing their traditions. It's more than just an app; it's a celebration of global cuisine and a commitment to making personalized nutrition accessible to everyone, one snap at a time.
